_national.labelling: Each of the 22 wine districts (borvidék) is a PDO (OEM, "oltalom alatt álló eredetmegjelölés", or "védett eredetű"), with smaller village, varietal and umbrella PDOs on top; regional PGIs (OFJ) such as Duna-Tisza-közi, Felső-Magyarország, Balaton, Dunántúl. Hungarian must weight is in degrees MM (Magyar Mustfok, roughly % sugar by weight). PDO specifications commonly use the tiers Classicus, Superior/Premium and Grand Superior/Super Premium.
_national.sweetness: EU terms: száraz (dry) max 4 g/l (or 9 with acidity rule), félszáraz max 12 (18), félédes max 45, édes over 45 g/l.

src.title: Villány PDO product specification, version 5 (harvests from 1 Aug 2019)

hu-debroi-harslevelu.labelling: Varietal PDO within the Eger district (registered 2007) for Hárslevelű from Debrő.

hu-eger.varieties: Whites incl. Leányka, Királyleányka, Olaszrizling, Hárslevelű, Chardonnay, Pinot Blanc, Sauvignon Blanc, Szürkebarát, Juhfark, Muscats; reds incl. Kékfrankos, Kadarka, Kékoportó (Portugieser), Blauburger, Zweigelt, Merlot, Cabernets, Pinot Noir, Syrah, Turán, Menoire, Bíbor Kadarka, Csókaszőlő.
hu-eger.min_alcohol: Superior and Grand Superior: grapes at least 20 MM (12.83% potential), wine at least 12.5% total and 12.0% actual.
hu-eger.max_yield: Classicus 100 hl/ha (13.6 t/ha hand-picked); Superior 60 hl/ha (8.1 t/ha); Grand Superior 35 hl/ha (6.0 t/ha).
hu-eger.styles: Generic district types plus Classicus, Superior and Grand Superior (white, red, rosé, siller, late harvest). Egri Bikavér (red blend) and Egri Csillag (white blend) have their own rules; any bull image or "bull's blood" wording is reserved for Egri Bikavér, any star image or "csillag" for Egri Csillag.
hu-eger.labelling: Grand Superior must name a dűlő. Village names need 85% origin; dűlő names (Grand Superior only) need 95%. Superior/Grand Superior plantings since 2010 at least 4,000 vines/ha.
hu-eger.other: Egri Bikavér (separate PDO spec, from the 2023/24 marketing year): blend of at least four varieties each above 5%, Kékfrankos 30 to 65% and the largest component, Turán max 10% (Turán and Bíbor Kadarka max 10% in Classicus); varieties Kékfrankos, Kadarka, Kékoportó, Blauburger, Zweigelt, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Sauvignon, Pinot Noir, Syrah, Menoire, Turán (plus Bíbor Kadarka in Classicus). Classicus: at least 8 days on skins, 6 months in wood (except light varieties), 12.0% minimum, 100 hl/ha, released 1 September after harvest. Superior: at least 14 days on skins, 12 months in wood, 12.5%, 60 hl/ha, class I and II/1 land only, released 31 October after harvest. Grand Superior: as Superior plus 35 hl/ha and a mandatory named dűlő (95% from it). Max 5 g/l sugar, no sweetening, vintage mandatory, glass bottles only.

hu-tokaj.varieties: Furmint, Hárslevelű, Kabar, Kövérszőlő, Sárgamuskotály (Muscat Blanc à Petits Grains), Zéta only (still and sparkling).
hu-tokaj.min_alcohol: Minimum total alcohol / actual alcohol / residual sugar: Eszencia 27.75% total, 1.2 to 8.0% actual, at least 450 g/l sugar, acidity at least 8 g/l. Aszú 19% total, at least 9% actual, at least 120 g/l. Száraz Szamorodni 12% actual, max 9 g/l. Édes Szamorodni, Fordítás, Máslás: 16% total, 9% actual, at least 60 g/l. Késői szüretelésű (late harvest): 13.6% total, at least 45 g/l. Fehér bor (dry/white): 10.6% total. Minimum grape sugar: aszú berries 45 refractometer % (438 g/l); Aszú, Fordítás, Máslás base wine 19 MM; Száraz Szamorodni and late harvest 21 MM; Édes Szamorodni 24.2 MM; white 17 MM; sparkling 14.9 MM.
hu-tokaj.max_yield: 10 t/ha (70 hl/ha) for all specialities and late harvest, aszú berries counted five-fold; Eszencia 2 t/ha of aszú berries and 6% juice yield; white wine and sparkling 14 t/ha (100 hl/ha); named dűlő wines 6 t/ha (42 hl/ha). Only class I and II cadastre land in 27 villages.
hu-tokaj.ageing: Aszú at least 18 months in wooden cask; Száraz Szamorodni at least 24 months in cask (traditionally under flor-like film); Édes Szamorodni, Fordítás and Máslás at least 6 months in cask. Sparkling (bottle fermentation only) at least 15 months in bottle, 24 months for vintage plus 1 month after disgorging.
hu-tokaj.release: Eszencia, Aszú and Száraz Szamorodni not before 1 January of the third year after harvest; Édes Szamorodni, Fordítás, Máslás from 1 January of the second year; late harvest from 1 January after harvest.
hu-tokaj.styles: Eszencia (free-run juice of aszú berries under their own weight, barely fermented); Aszú (hand-picked botrytised berries macerated in must, fermenting new wine or wine of the same vintage); Szamorodni ("as it was born", whole bunches with botrytised and healthy berries; száraz or édes, full name mandatory); Fordítás (must or wine poured over pressed aszú paste); Máslás (must or new wine poured over Aszú or Szamorodni lees); late harvest; white; Tokaji pezsgő (traditional method). Ratios: max 6 L Eszencia per 100 kg aszú berries; Eszencia, Aszú and Fordítás together max 220 L new wine per 100 kg aszú berries; Máslás max 105 L per 100 L lees. Adding Eszencia to Aszú is traditional.
hu-tokaj.sweetness: Aszú at least 120 g/l. Labels may still read Aszú 3, 4, 5 or 6 puttonyos, but "6 puttonyos" requires at least 150 g/l; with the 120 g/l floor the old 3 and 4 puttonyos levels cannot be met in practice. White wine must state sugar if above 18 g/l.
hu-tokaj.labelling: Vintage mandatory (85% rule). "Borkülönlegesség" (wine speciality) may replace the PDO term for Eszencia, Aszú, Szamorodni, Fordítás, Máslás; "muzeális bor" (museum wine) allowed. Dűlő (single vineyard) names from the spec list need 100% site, 100% vintage and 100% variety if named. Specialities bottled only inside the region and only in the traditional Tokaji bottle (clear, cylindrical, long neck; mainly 0.5 L); late harvest and white wines also bottled locally. No enrichment, sweetening or acid adjustment for any speciality.
hu-tokaj.other: Hand harvest compulsory for all types except dry white; aszú berries picked berry by berry. New plantings since 2009 at least 4,000 vines/ha.

src.title: Tokaj PDO product specification, version 10 (harvests from 1 Aug 2025)

hu-villany.varieties: Reds: Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Kékfrankos, Kékoportó (Portugieser), Kadarka, Pinot Noir, Syrah, Zweigelt, Blauburger, Menoire. Whites incl. Olaszrizling, Hárslevelű, Chardonnay, Tramini, Muscats. Super Premium: 100% Cabernet Franc only.
hu-villany.min_alcohol: Classicus grapes 14.9 MM (9% potential); Premium red 19 MM (Cabernets and Merlot 20 MM, Kadarka and Kékoportó 17.5 MM); Super Premium 20 MM (12.83%); late harvest 22.5 MM.
hu-villany.max_yield: Classicus 13 t/ha (90 hl/ha); Premium 8.5 t/ha (60 hl/ha); Premium late harvest 6 t/ha; Super Premium 5 t/ha (35 hl/ha).
hu-villany.ageing: Premium red at least 1 year in wood (Kadarka and Portugieser Premium 6 months); Super Premium at least 2 years, at least 1 of them in wood.
hu-villany.styles: Generic, Classicus, Classicus vörös Redy (light red from 51 to 66% Kékoportó plus 20 to 49% Blauburger, Kadarka, Kékfrankos or Zweigelt; screwcap only, no variety named), Premium, Super Premium; late harvest; sparkling and carbonated semi-sparkling.
hu-villany.labelling: Cabernet Franc at Premium or Super Premium must be labelled "Villányi Franc"; Super Premium exists only as Villányi Franc. Village names (85%) on Classicus, Premium, Super Premium; dűlő names (95%) only on Premium and Super Premium. Single-variety labels need 85%. Premium and Super Premium must be made and bottled in Baranya county cellars, glass only. Sweet wines only from natural sugar of Hárslevelű, Muscats, Olaszrizling, Rajnai rizling or Tramini.
